description.value: The Mint is a long-established Himalayan dining lounge in downtown Victoria, founded in April 2002, blending traditional Himalayan dishes like Tibetan Momos and butter chicken curry with contemporary West Coast fare and craft cocktails. Located below street level on Douglas Street, it pairs an eclectic food menu with rotating local craft beer taps and a live entertainment program featuring DJs and performances. The venue has a private dining area available for functions and draws a devoted local crowd.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack (10 spaces) at 89m; rack (6 spaces) at 90m; rack (10 spaces) at 95m. Total: 26 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website for The Mint is fully accessible and provides the primary evidence. The address (1414 Douglas St Victoria, BC V8W 2G2) and phone (+1 250-386-6468) are confirmed on multiple pages. The menu explicitly labels vegan and vegetarian items and states 'Many items can be made dairy or gluten free,' confirming dietary options. No mention of bike parking, bike racks, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or device charging appears anywhere on the website, so those remain null.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; phone (+1 250-386-6468) sourced from website only — contact_confirmed.phone set to null.
Venue is below street level and opens at 4PM, limiting daytime utility for touring cyclists.
OSM opening_hours (Mo-Su 17:00-02:00) conflicts slightly with website stating 'Open Daily 4PM - 2AM'; minor discrepancy (5PM vs 4PM).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The Mint is a legitimate, long-running food and drink establishment that cyclists could enjoy, but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) could be confirmed from the website. A direct visit or contact is needed to verify these before inclusion.
